decision.reason: [ev-eacfddf95197] is the 0.86.0 compatibility document. It states as a standing fact that prometheus-operator requires Kubernetes >= v1.16.0, without saying "now requires" or giving a previous value. Nothing shown proves that the requirement moved in this release. The other evidence [ev-f240b6ac3b67][ev-83fc26f44be6] only covers the Alertmanager and Prometheus spec.version changes in the Helm chart, and the compat validator found no Kubernetes row in either release. Missing: the 0.85.x compatibility statement (or a diff of compatibility.md between 0.85 and 0.86), or a release note saying the minimum changed; if it did not change, this item should be rejected as not a change.
